%----------------------------------------------------------------------------
\chapter{\bevezetes}\label{chap:intro}
%----------------------------------------------------------------------------

A verifier that accepts a credential must know that its issuer has not revoked it. Today this
check downloads the whole revocation list~\cite{lamport1978time}. The \registry answers it from a
summary instead; \autoref{chap:design} describes it and \autoref{chap:measurements} measures it.
